zh: 桌面 Agent 支持识别 Claude「要在单独的会话中启动吗？」选择卡，可在网页端直接选择「在此处操作」或「新建会话」，点击前后均会核对确认。
WorkBuddy 会话计时支持读取按日归档的历史日志，往日会话也能显示准确的首字耗时。
AI 入门课程新增「一个 HTML 文件就是一件工具」章节，并优化「方法外借、数据不出内网」的中英文内容。
en: Desktop Agent now detects Claude's "start in a separate session?" prompt and lets you choose "Continue here" or "New session" from the web, with checks before and after the click.
WorkBuddy conversation timing now reads daily archived logs, so past conversations show accurate first-token timing.
The AI introductory course adds a "one HTML file is one tool" section and refines the bilingual "borrow methods, keep data inside" content.
